column3: Close to the Hebrew; “why should my spirit not be short?” is rendered “why should I not be impatient?”
Close to the Hebrew; “they lift up [the voice]” is rendered “They sing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they complete their days in good” is rendered “spend their days in wealth,” and שְׁאוֹל “the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “They say” to mark the first line as the friends’ claim.
Close to the Hebrew; חֻצָּצוּ (“cut off”) is rendered “cut in half.”
Close to the Hebrew; נָדִיב (“noble”) is rendered “the prince.”
